en: A tinted winter photograph of a snow-covered village in hilly terrain, with scattered houses and chalets among fields and forested slopes. Leafless trees frame the foreground, and a lone skier stands on a snowy path. In the upper right corner, there is printed text in German that reads "Winter in Bärenfels." The overall image has a blue-toned monochrome style typical of early 20th‑century winter postcards.
